authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 8376 *peṭṭa gives peṭ/pẽṭ and explicitly aspirated peṭh belly. These e-vowel belly forms select the first branch. Reviewed comparison: Goj peṭʰ “belly” (f_4boaexu44bdgk). Possible intra-IA transfer remains open; source forms and provenance are preserved.
